## Change summary

Describe the user-visible problem and the smallest change that fixes it.

## Checklist

- [ ] I described the risk of this change.
- [ ] I tested on a disposable scene or reproduction.
- [ ] I listed the exact commands I ran and their results.
- [ ] I described any compatibility impact.
- [ ] I described any safety impact.
- [ ] I confirm no scene, asset, or private data is included.
